scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root=(Get-Location).Path; if (Test-Path (Join-Path $root '.venv312\Scripts\python.exe')) { $py=(Join-Path $root '.venv312\Scripts\python.exe') } elseif (Test-Path (Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe')) { $py=(Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe') } else { Write-Error 'No Python virtual environment found. Create .venv or .venv312 first.'; exit 1 }; Push-Location (Join-Path $root 'backend_run'); & $py -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
